remarks: This well-maintained, classic Colonial boasts 4 bedrooms/3 full baths & will check most of your boxes. Tucked away on a tree-lined street, but just blocks from Transit Road's conveniences. Inside, the eat-in kitchen includes a pantry, island & all appliances. 2026 electric stove, microwave, dishwasher & backsplash. The kitchen overlooks a sunken family room with hardwood floors, vaulted ceiling, fireplace & 2026 remote-controlled fan. Spacious living room connects to a formal dining room. Entryway office with French doors & double bookcases. First floor full bath & laundry hook-ups. Upstairs is the primary suite and 3 additional bedrooms. The suite features: a 9' foot tray ceiling, walk-in closet & soaking tub as well as new carpet, shower surround & double-basin vanity countertop. Additional bedrooms have hardwood floors, ceiling fans & another full bath. Partially finished basement has loads of potential with a media room, bonus room, additional storage & laundry hook-ups. Central heating/air, vinyl siding, updated Anderson windows throughout & 2026 hot water tanks. New double-wide driveway leads to the 2.5 CAG with a new opener. The fully-fenced backyard is ready for relaxation or hosting. Complete with a deck & awning, above ground pool, concrete patio as well as a workshop & storage in the shed. Williamsville Schools.
